versions.changelog:
aim-trade-news v1.0.0 released

- Initial release enabling users to query recent (1–3 days) foreign trade news with AI-generated titles and summaries.
- Includes automated credential checking and guided token setup—no manual file editing needed by users.
- Uses AEP Gateway trending_hub API for real-time information retrieval; no data caching or local storage.
- Presents results in a clear, formatted style with updated date and source links.
- Not intended for domestic news, entertainment, or real-time stock/currency markets.
